sources.title: World Bank Group Explores USDC Payments With Citi
World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments

stories.narrEn: The Defiant reports: Circle's USDC infrastructure and Citi's banking connections will underpin an exploration of stablecoin-based development-fund payments, not a live rollout. According to Decrypt, the institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds. According to Cointelegraph, the initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries. CryptoSlate reports: Citi would connect the proposed settlement route to existing banking networks, and Circle would provide the infrastructure to issue and settle funds in USDC.

According to CNA, the meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen is the first-ever three-way meeting between the leaders of China, the United States and Russia.
